whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pip.conf no longer carries a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
